cp4:1.1: Kurudhammacariyaṃ tatiyaṃ Kusāvatimhi nagare yadā āsiṃ mahīpati Mahāsudassano nāma cakkavattī mahabbalo, || ||
cp4:2.1: Tatthāhaṃ divase tikkhattuṃ ghosāpemi tahiṃ tahiṃ: ko kiṃ icchati pattheti kassa kiṃ dīyatū dhanaṃ. || ||
cp4:3.1: Ko chātako ko tasito ko mālaṃ ko vilepanaṃ nānārattāni vatthāni ko naggo paridahissati. || ||
cp4:4.1: Ko pathe chattam-ādeti ko' pāhanā mudū subhā. Iti sāyañca pāto ca ghosāpemi {tahiṃ} tahiṃ. || ||
cp4:5.1: Na taṃ dasasu ṭhānesu na pi ṭhānasatesu vā anekasataṭhānesu paṭiyattaṃ yācake dhanaṃ. || ||
cp4:6.1: Divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ yadi eti vaṇibbako laddhā yad-icchikaṃ bhogaṃ pūrahattho va gacchati. || ||
cp4:7.1: Evarūpaṃ mahādānaṃ adāsiṃ yāvajīvikaṃ na p' āhaṃ dessaṃ dhanaṃ dammi na pi natthi nicayo mayi. || ||
cp4:8.1: Yathā pi āturo nāma rogato parimuttiyā dhanena vejjaṃ tappetvā rogato parimuccati, || ||
cp4:9.1: Tath' evāhaṃ jānamāno paripūretum-asesato ūnamanam pūrayituṃ demi dānaṃ vaṇibbake nirālayo apaccāso sambodhim-anupattiyā ti. || ||
